decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera in the firm’s core space-optics business with its own webpage, it fits the announced strategy and prior R&D commitments, so management would be very reluctant to withdraw it quickly.

The modular navigation camera is close to the established offer, visibly promoted, and aligned with the move toward more flexible spacecraft sensors, which makes continued support more likely than exit.

The sensor suite extends the firm’s established capabilities and has been publicly presented, so sunk development effort and strategic relevance would encourage management to persist unless clear failure emerged.

Although the miniaturized LiDAR sensor appears less publicly committed than the others, it still matches the firm’s direction toward compact space-qualified sensors, so escalation of commitment still favors keeping it on the market.
